newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Petkoff rules out wage hike decree.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Petkoff rules out wage hike decree.

text.p: The Venezuelan government is not planning to order a salary increase by decree to settle a dispute between union and business leaders that has provoked a 12-hour national work stoppage, Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff said
"We haven't considered that," Petkoff told the Televen network.
He added that both union and business leaders have rejected the use of a salary hike decree to end the dispute.
Unions staged a 12-hour walkout Wednesday to pressure private sector companies to raise wages in accordance with an agreement to reform the social security system.
The government has supported unions in their call for higher wages. Business chamber leaders insist that about 90 percent of their members have increased pay.
After an emergency meeting between government, business and union leaders Friday, a commission was set up to investigate whether salary increases have been awarded.
